update.releaseNotes:
v5.9.81 - Spark Trait Reroll Sliders, Low-Energy Racing Gate, Discord Fan Milestones, Per-Scenario Training Blacklist
Added ----- - Spark Trait Reroll sliders: Training Settings → Behavior → Spark Traits now exposes "Max Rerolls per Spark" (0–20) and "Stop at Star Count" (0–10) sliders. Previously these were read by the bot but had no UI controls. - Low-energy gate for optional races: Racing Settings → Race Behavior → "Minimum Energy for Optional Racing" slider (0–100%, default 0 = off). When set above 0, the bot skips optional extra races while energy is below the threshold. Hard requirements (fan/trophy goals, force-racing) always bypass this gate. - Discord fan milestone notifications: Discord Settings → Notifications → "Fan Milestones" text field. Enter comma-separated fan counts (e.g. 10000,50000,100000). Each milestone fires a Discord DM once per career when the trainee crosses it. - Per-scenario training blacklist: Training Settings → Behavior now has separate blacklist selectors for URA Finale, Unity Cup, and Trackblazer. When a scenario-specific blacklist is non-empty it overrides the global blacklist for that scenario only; leave empty to fall back to the global blacklist.
